name: Oakland Zoo – Bay to Zoo
description: Oakland Zoo is home to over 850 native and exotic animals on 100 acres in the Oakland hills. The zoo is committed to conservation and education, featuring the California Trail exhibit showcasing native wildlife.
fullDescription: Oakland Zoo is home to over 850 native and exotic animals on 100 acres in the Oakland hills. The zoo is committed to conservation and education, featuring the California Trail exhibit showcasing native wildlife.
whatTheyOffer:
- Bay to Zoo tickets for low-income Bay Area residents with a Golden State Advantage EBT card or California WIC card
- Up to 2 adult tickets (ages 15-64) at $5 each
- Up to 2 senior tickets (65+) and up to 4 child tickets (ages 2-14) at $3 each
- One free parking pass
- Good for regular daytime hours (not special events like Glowfari)
- Regular ticket prices vary by day; booking early costs less
howToGetIt: Reserve Bay to Zoo tickets online in advance, since weekends and holidays sell out. On weekdays, tickets may be available at entry if not sold out; call 510-632-9525 x100 to check first. Bring your EBT or WIC card.
keywords: Oakland Zoo, Bay to Zoo, $5 admission, low-income, EBT, CalFresh, WIC, animals, California Trail, family
